question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Taut
solution:
The correct answer is: **Tight**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"taut"** means something that is stretched or pulled tight; not slack. (कसावदार)

 
 
• **Example: **The rope was** taut**, ready to bear the weight of the climber.
 
 
 
• **"Tight" **refers to something that is firmly or closely fixed in place; not loose or slack. (कस हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **She pulled the knot** tight **to ensure it wouldn't come undone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'taut' **is **'tight'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Tight**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Slack **(ढीला): Not tight; loose.

 
 
• **Example:** The rope went slack after the load was removed.
 
 
 
• **Torn **(फटा हुआ): Damaged by having been pulled apart or ripped.
 
 
• **Example: **He wore a torn shirt to the party, which looked quite out of place.
 
 
 
• **Flaccid** (ढीला): Soft and hanging loosely or limply.
 
 
• **Example:** The patient's muscles became flaccid after the surgery.
